TextView.android:text: CampusSaathi is a smart campus utility application designed to seamlessly connect students with nearby campus services — including printing, food, stationery, rentals, and much more.\n\nOur purpose is simple: to simplify campus life by bringing every essential service into one intuitive, unified platform — so students spend less time searching and more time learning.
Students are unaware of what services are available on campus and where to find them.
Finding nearby shops or service providers is time-consuming and frustrating without a map or directory.
There is no single, unified platform that aggregates all campus services in one place for students.
Students waste valuable academic time searching for resources that should be instantly accessible.
Browse all campus services in your vicinity instantly.
Navigate campus with a real-time, interactive map.
View opening hours, rates, and contact details for each service.
Directly communicate with service providers through the app.
Designed for students — clean, fast, and intuitive.

Our vision is to create a thriving digital ecosystem for college campuses — where every student can instantly access the services they need, from anywhere on campus.\n\nWe aim to eliminate friction from student life and empower service providers to reach their customers effortlessly. As CampusSaathi grows, we aspire to expand across multiple colleges and universities, becoming the go-to platform for campus service discovery across the country.
Passionate about crafting seamless mobile experiences.
Building robust APIs and scalable server architecture.
Designing intuitive layouts and user journeys that delight.
Architecting efficient data models and optimized queries.
Ensuring quality, reliability, and a bug-free experience.
